Axiom: Amplifications are opt-in: after triage the agent PROPOSES a set from the catalog, the operator confirms; the default for small tasks is «none active». State an empty proposal explicitly — «усиления не нужны, потому что …» — it is a valid triage outcome, not a silent omission. A confirmed amplification becomes a map topic and its directive loads lazily via `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE` at the moment its topic opens, never up front.
